identityDecision: Create one canonical Intermodal Tank Transport record. Use ITT and Intermodal Tank Transport (USA), Inc. as aliases. The Houston-based U.S. entity is the North American operating identity for the global ISO-tank platform; Depot Connect International, ConGlobal and TRAC Intermodal are distinct companies and are not duplicates.
infrastructureScopeDecision: Include. Apollo's June 2023 announcement is explicitly an Apollo Infrastructure Funds structured equity investment in an asset- and depot-intensive ISO-tank logistics platform. Apollo described ITT as the largest U.S.-based ISO-tank operator and as serving an essential transportation-infrastructure role.
censusCorrection: Replace the census's dead 2024 acquisition URL and 2024 investment year. The transaction was a June 13, 2023 structured equity investment, not a 2024 acquisition. The exact broader legal closing date, exact percentage and specific current fund or vehicle are not publicly disclosed.

ownershipDecision.vehicle: Apollo Infrastructure Funds (specific current fund and legal vehicle not publicly disclosed)
ownershipDecision.stake: Structured equity investment (exact percentage not publicly disclosed)
ownershipDecision.closingDecision: Apollo announced an agreement on June 13, 2023. Apollo Infrastructure Company later disclosed that a subsidiary acquired a control equity position in a matching global ISO-tank logistics and depot-services provider on November 6, 2023, and separately disclosed interests in Atlas Tank Parent, L.P. This supports closed-active status but does not prove the broader transaction's exact closing date or current holding vehicle.
ownershipDecision.currentEvidence: Apollo's 2025 Responsible & Sustainable Portfolio Supplement lists ITT among its reporting companies, and Apollo's current David Cohen biography says the Apollo Infrastructure partner currently serves on ITT's board.
ownershipDecision.exitSearch: No Apollo sale, transfer, exit or ITT successor transaction was identified through 2026-08-08. ITT remained operational under the same brand and acquired Bulk Tainer Group in August 2025.

companyDecision.subsector: ISO tank container logistics and depot services
companyDecision.operatingBoundary: Count ITT as the manager-level platform. Treat Bulk Tainer Group and other acquired operating entities as subsidiaries or bolt-ons beneath ITT rather than additional Apollo portfolio companies.

repoDecision.fundDecision: Use fundName null. Do not infer AIOF III, Apollo Infrastructure Company or another exact fund from the broader Apollo Infrastructure Funds disclosure.
